About platinum as a commodity

Platinum is both a precious metal and an industrial commodity, with major uses in catalytic converters, hydrogen fuel cells, and jewelry. Its price is influenced by supply from South Africa (which produces roughly 70% of global supply), industrial demand, and investor sentiment.

Unlike gold and silver, platinum's price is more sensitive to industrial cycles. Compare its daily and 30-day changes with the longer trend rather than relying on a single close.
